SCOPE & PURPOSE

The training task.

  • SYSTEM IMPLEMENTATION
  • REPRODUCIBLE ENVIRONMENTS

Designed for challenging real-world engineering tasks, the dataset provides specification-driven system implementation data, covering design specifications, engineering implementation, and correctness verification. It can be used for coding agent training, evaluation, and research.

DATA PRODUCTION & CONSTRUCTION

METHOD & WORKFLOW

Data production strengths

We have expert data production capabilities across software development, operations, DevOps, and system design, supported by domain-specific engineering experts and review resources. Lead domain experts ensure technical correctness, while independent reviewers and evaluation specialists conduct secondary verification. Our workflow covers complete project construction, reproducible environment setup, task and reference implementation development, public/hidden test design, and rubric development.

  1. 01CONSTRUCT

    Complete engineering projects

    Build complete projects with reproducible environment setup.

  2. 02IMPLEMENT

    Tasks & reference implementations

    Develop tasks and reference implementations for specification-driven system work.

  3. 03TEST

    Public & hidden tests

    Design public and hidden tests and develop evaluation rubrics.

  4. 04REVIEW

    Independent secondary verification

    Lead domain experts ensure technical correctness, with secondary verification by independent reviewers and evaluation specialists.
